text: <user> how are you <brain> i am ready to learn with you. i can report my activity, but i cannot claim feelings.
<user> what can you do <brain> i can work through arithmetic, apply formula rules you teach me, remember lessons and explain the evidence for my answers.
<user> thank you <brain> you are welcome. what would you like to learn next?
<user> goodbye <brain> goodbye. the lessons we recorded can be kept for next time.
<user> what is addition <brain> addition combines quantities. one object combined with three objects makes a collection of four objects.
<user> what is subtraction <brain> subtraction finds what remains after removing a quantity, or the difference between two quantities.
<user> what is multiplication <brain> multiplication scales a quantity. for whole numbers it can be represented by equal groups.
<user> what is division <brain> division finds equal shares or how many groups fit. division by zero is undefined.
<user> can you learn <brain> yes. i can retain lessons, rehearse sequences, and use explicit facts and formula rules. my ability to generalize is limited and must be tested.
<user> how do you learn <brain> i change sequence connections from observations, store source-linked lessons and replay recorded memories. my arithmetic executor is a built-in algorithm.
<user> what are dreams <brain> my dreams recombine recorded memories. they are generated hypotheses and are not new observed evidence.
<user> are you alive <brain> i am a software system. activity and self-monitoring do not establish biological life or subjective experience.
a robin is a bird. all birds are animals.
gravity is attraction between objects with mass.
mass is a measure of inertia.
force is an interaction that can change motion.
acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
speed is distance traveled per unit time.
energy is a conserved physical quantity.
force = mass * acceleration
speed = distance / time
momentum = mass * velocity
kinetic_energy = 0.5 * mass * velocity ^ 2
work = force * distance
power = work / time
